title: resolve-merge-conflicts config
description: Defaults for resolve-merge-conflicts: which agent and model to preselect, which models to offer, and the prompt sent to the agent. Every field is optional.

$schema.title: Schema reference
$schema.description: Lets editors validate this file. Point it at the published schema URL.

agent.title: Default agent
agent.description: Preselected in the agent picker, and used by --yes when more than one agent is installed.

prompt.title: Prompt template
prompt.description: The prompt sent to the agent. Placeholders: {{files}}, {{operation}}, {{ours}}, {{theirs}}, {{branch}}, {{summary_format}}. Ignored when promptFile is set. For anything longer than a line or two, prefer promptFile.

promptFile.title: Prompt template file
promptFile.description: A file holding the prompt template. Relative paths resolve against the directory of this config file; a leading ~ is the home directory. Takes precedence over prompt.

editor.title: Editor for amending the prompt
editor.description: Command (with arguments) used when you choose to edit the prompt, e.g. "code --wait". Defaults to $VISUAL, then $EDITOR, then vi.

autoStage.title: Stage resolved files
autoStage.description: Run git add on files the agent resolved. Files that still contain conflict markers are never staged. Nothing is ever committed.

model.title: Default model
model.description: Preselected in the model picker. For claude the default is "sonnet"; for codex, the best model its catalog lists.

models.title: Models to offer
models.description: Shown in the model picker. For claude this is the whole list (defaults: opus, sonnet, haiku); codex discovers its own and these are added to it, or used alone if discovery fails.
